annotations.title: Create a polygon, star or free shape

description: Create a polygon (Polygon): either a regular polygon or star from bounds_mm with sides (3–100; a triangle is sides 3) and star_inset_percent (0 = regular polygon, greater than 0 = star with the inner points inset by that percentage), or a closed free shape from points_mm[] (3–200 anchor points {x, y} in page coordinates, straight segments; an arrow is a points_mm shape) – exactly one of the two ways. Colour, stroke, tint, gradient angle, text_wrap, layer_name and name as in create_ellipse. Returns frame_id, type "polygon", bounds_mm, sides and star_inset_percent (null for a free shape), point_count, points_mm[] read back from the path (anchor points only), fill and stroke as create_ellipse, landed_on_page_id, landed_on_page_name, swatch_ids. Note: text wrap by object shape follows the polygon outline. A timed-out call may still have created the object – check get_page_state before repeating.

bounds_mm.description: Position and size in mm from the top left corner of the page (or spread with coordinate_space "spread").

x.description: Left edge in mm; negative allowed for bleed (Anschnitt).

y.description: Top edge in mm; negative allowed.

coordinate_space.description: Reference for x/y: "page" (default) is the top left corner of page_id, identical on left and right pages; "spread" is the top left corner of the spread (Druckbogen) – the right page of a spread starts at x = page width.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

fill_hex.description: Fill colour as hex, e.g. "#E30613". Creates an RGB swatch.

fill_swatch_name.description: Exact name of an existing swatch for the fill – colour, tint or gradient swatch (see list_swatches). Not together with fill_hex.

fill_tint_percent.description: Tint of the fill swatch in percent (0–100).

gradient_fill_angle_deg.description: Angle of a linear gradient fill in degrees (-180 to 180); only visible with a gradient swatch as fill.

gradient_stroke_angle_deg.description: Angle of a linear gradient stroke in degrees (-180 to 180); only visible with a gradient swatch as stroke.

layer_name.description: Existing layer to create the object on (see list_layers). Default: the active layer.

name.description: Object name (label), shown in InDesign's layers panel.

points_mm.description: Anchor points of a closed free shape in mm (page coordinates), 3 to 200. Not together with bounds_mm/sides.

sides.description: Number of sides for a regular polygon or points of a star (3–100). Needs bounds_mm.

star_inset_percent.description: 0 (default) = regular polygon; greater than 0 = star, inset of the inner points in percent.

stroke_hex.description: Stroke colour as hex. Creates an RGB swatch.

stroke_swatch_name.description: Exact name of an existing swatch for the stroke (colour, tint or gradient). Not together with stroke_hex.

stroke_tint_percent.description: Tint of the stroke swatch in percent (0–100).

stroke_weight_pt.description: Stroke weight in points (1 pt with a warning when a stroke colour is given without it).

text_wrap.description: Text wrap of the new object: none, bounding_box or object_shape. Without it the document default applies – pass "none" when text lies underneath.
